description: Defines the InputTarget structure and related enums and methods for dispatching input events to specific windows in Android's input dispatcher system.

classes.name: InputTarget
classes.description: Represents how an input event is dispatched to a specific window, including flags, input channel, transforms, and pointer IDs.

methods.name: addPointers
methods.description: Adds pointer IDs and associated transforms to the InputTarget.

methods.name: setDefaultPointerTransform
methods.description: Sets the default transform for pointers.

methods.name: useDefaultPointerTransform
methods.description: Checks if default pointer transform should be used (no specific pointers set).

methods.name: getPointerInfoString
methods.description: Returns a string describing pointer information.
